name: cosmetic
description: Marks a changed file whose change is formatting or comments only — whitespace, line breaks, semicolons, comments — by BABLR's verdict of HEAD against the working tree: a ≈ badge and a dimmed name, in Source Control and the Explorer alike. Its changes come from the editor's git (editor.git.*), its verdicts from the editor's BABLR (editor.annotations.classify); `cosmetic.list` says each changed file's.
